research_route.source: research/模块化搭建与测试消融实施计划_2026-10-28.md §18.5
research_route.requires: configuration/code/data/role hashes, seeds, actual steps, selection, weights/structure, predictions/diagnostics/costs
research_route.does_not_generally_mandate: one independent uncompressed tensor ZIP per optimizer step for every historical study

frozen_requirements: pending optimizer intent never replayed automatically
C3.old_physical_contract: immutable stages/NNNNNN/state.pt + intent.json + record.json; do not replace historical paths

C13.explicit_future_requirement: complete state each update; no reduction in retention frequency
C13.reserve_derivation: per state24*trainable_parameters +4MiB +256*selection_events*devval_centers; multiplied by every saved initial/update state

C11.reuse: whole-file SHA content-addressing and original-byte verification
C11.priority_capsules: initial/selected/current coverage and incremental dependency closure
C11.omitted_intermediates: transport/recovery exposure accounting, not permission to delete source states or lower future retention

reversible_physical_choices: ZIP-member-aligned chunks and bounded XOR+zlib deltas
new_optional_v2.unchanged_logical_contract: every committed state and all original bytes recoverable with original full-file SHA

production_integration: explicit separate future runner/registration required; optional transaction API is not a monkeypatch of historical C3/C13 writer
migration_limit: post-hoc importer leaves originals present and therefore increases current occupied space; no deletion or move authorized
storage_approval: only existing authorized LXC roots used for pilot; no new mount/device/offhost destination approved or selected
